fixed.method: the forward baseline stage1_init.d1_target_aware.scored_v1@v1, resolved by shared.forward_baseline (operators, positions, support, KL references, beam width 6 delayed_prune warm-up 1, pareto@v2, micro-batch 3, length_sorted_v1, scored_v1) -- never edited to save cost
fixed.geometry_and_state_evaluation: the D-series target geometry and state_eval@v1 (stages.phase_a3.a3_session.path_spec, stages.phase_d1.d1_session)
fixed.operator_order_and_profile_per_operator: free search variables over the dose's two profiles (base, rh), as in D1

execution.why: cost (maintainer 2026-10-19: optimize first, identity unchanged). Both options are execution only; the bench showed both bit-identical on this card (DEPTH tables, removal order, child bytes; state ids, digests and measurements). prune_weights=False keeps every state's bytes on the network volume so a resumed session restores instead of recomputing.

search.commit: stage1_selection.commit of the ranking's Top-1 complete leaf

recovery.rule: the frozen recipe unchanged except run identity, pack path and student_path (the C1 override set); the same seed for every dose

evaluation.coverage: EVERY item of every unit (720 + 846 + 150); masks decide formal rows, not generation
evaluation.report: scripts/shared/evaluation/eval_set_scoring.py report (per unit and capability; no pooled score)

analysis.H1: descriptive: per dose, the committed Top-1's operator order and per-step profile; per operator FFN/ATTENTION per-layer kept-set Jaccard, DEPTH removed-set Jaccard, WIDTH subspace overlap, between doses (2x vs 1x, 4x vs 2x, 4x vs 1x), each beside chance; no stability claim
analysis.H2: eval-set-1 formal rows, every unit and capability separately: fluid static items over the four static axes and per axis, interactive separately; capability units, behaviour, safety, legacy (in-sample) each separately; knowledge reported as supplementary
analysis.H3: the 1x/2x/4x shape of H1 and H2, described
analysis.separation: structure (H1), the Top-1's step-0 state evaluation against the teacher (KL and the other state_eval@v1 terms, from the search journal), the recovery's own training record, and the recovered student's capabilities (H2) are reported side by side and never combined into one number

statistics.intervals: rule-family cluster bootstrap (10,000 resamples, stratified by axis) for fluid; item-paired bootstrap for the capability units; intervals cover EVALUATION sampling only
not_claimed: a pure volume effect (rule-family diversity rises with dose)

analysis.no_stop_rule: maintainer 2026-10-19: a low 1x does not cancel 2x/4x; all three doses run

budget_rule: before each launch the session's hard cap must fit what is left of the $90 after everything already spent and the volume's reservation, AND the expected cost of the remaining doses plus a $5 margin must still fit; otherwise no new paid session
retry_policy: before formal measurement: ordinary failures repaired and retried (P12.1). After it began: a failed session is preserved and the SAME dose resumes from the network volume -- journal restore, an existing trained student evaluated rather than retrained, finished evaluation units rescored rather than regenerated. Never a second complete measurement of a dose.

pricing.basis: write_formal_proposal.py's per-operator minutes (pilot telemetry on the same card, D2's 92-expansion trajectory), DEPTH divided by the bench's full-round prefix-reuse speedup, overhead replaced by the bench's device-validation expansion
